name: Seed III balanced English / Norwegian / code
notes: Weights are deterministic training-window sampling targets; actual nonpadding token proportions are reported separately.
Book catalog/RDF metadata is reviewed before admission. Unknown rights or failed downloads are exclusions, not silently accepted sources.
Wikipedia is a dated, openly licensed web-text source, not unrestricted OpenWebText. Preserve article URLs, source-file hashes, attribution/history links and the dataset license snapshot.
Existing book/repository/author holdouts remain held out. Refreshes of a repository share its existing split.
No raw corpus or private node keys belong in the portable source release.
